chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ibrahim ibn Ziyad al-Karkhi, who said:

I purchased a bondwoman for Abu Abdillah عليه السلام. Then when I went to pay them, I said, “I will seek a reduction from them.” He said, “No. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله forbade seeking a reduction after the deal has been concluded.”

key_terms.أَسْتَحِطُّهُمْ: to ask them to reduce the price or give a discount
key_terms.أَنْقُدُهُمْ: to pay them the agreed price
key_terms.جَارِيَةً: a bondwoman or female slave being purchased in the transaction
key_terms.ٱلصَّفْقَةِ: the concluded bargain or sale transaction
key_terms.ٱلِٱسْتِحْطَاطِ: seeking a price reduction after agreement

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to ask for a discount after a sale agreement has already been concluded?
ai.summary: This hadith states that once a sale has been concluded, seeking a further price reduction afterward is forbidden. It reflects a Prophetic sunnah (prophetic tradition) of fairness and finality in commercial dealings.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3852 - Al-Hasan bin Mahbub narrated from Ibrahim bin Ziyad Al-Karkhi who said:

I purchased a bondwoman for Abu Abdillah (as).
When I was about to pay them, I said: "I will try to get a discount from them."
Imam (as) said: "No, indeed the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) forbade seeking a discount after the deal has been concluded."
